manual.title: Go-live: flip LIVE_MODE=True
manual.description: Brier gate cleared (BS<=0.25). Steps: (1) Verify EOA sig type 0 with $1.00 test order -- confirm no "maker address not allowed" error. (2) Set LIVE_MODE=True in bot_v2.py ~line 2315, syntax-check, restart. (3) Set circuit_dry_run: false in config.json (requires restart). LIVE_APPROVAL_MODE=True gates each order via Telegram.

manual.title: Review meta_shadow.jsonl -- around June 24
manual.description: LightGBM NO model (val_brier=0.1979) shadow soak started June 10. Check data/meta_shadow.jsonl around June 24 (2-week mark): verify mult_would direction -- higher multipliers on eventual winners, lower on losers. If direction is correct, flip meta_apply_mode: live in config.json (hot-reload, no restart).

manual.title: Review recency_bias_shadow.jsonl at 30 flagged entries
manual.description: Count lines in data/recency_bias_shadow.jsonl where rb_signal=true. For those where mult_would>1.0: compare win_rate vs overall bot win_rate. If flagged entries win at >65% (vs ~59% base), flip rb_apply_mode: live in config.json (hot-reload, no restart). If neutral or worse, raise rb_delta_threshold from 1.5 to 2.0 and continue shadow.

auto.title: Re-run GEPA optimizer at n = 300
auto.description: Run: python3 config_optimizer.py optimize --trials 200 --walk-forward 4. Compare vs baseline run 20260601_224455. kelly 0.45 suggestion: IGNORE. Hour tightening: credible if it reappears.

auto.title: Retrain LightGBM meta-model at n = 300
auto.description: Run: python3 train_meta_model.py. NO model should improve (more live NO rows). YES model should finally pass gate (~50 live YES by n=300). Deploy if val_brier < current baseline (NO: 0.1979). Check data/meta_shadow.jsonl direction before flipping meta_apply_mode: live.

auto.title: SM shadow analysis at n = 300
auto.description: Check data/sm_shadow.jsonl for rows where sm_convergence=true. Compare win rate of convergence rows vs agree_strong rows. If convergence tier improves win rate: flip sm_apply_mode: live in config.json (hot-reload).
